description: National Physical Planning Department - Urban Development Areas : Kolawenigama Raja Maha Vihara and Bingiriya Devagiri Raja Maha Vihara area.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of two specific land areas ("Kolawenigama Raja Maha Vihara Area" and "Bingiriya Devagiri Raja Maha Vihara Area") as urban development areas under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It includes detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extents, and locations, making it clearly a land-related gazette under Type 4 classification. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapakse, it does not focus on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather uses his ministerial authority to make land development declarations.
